purpose: Each criterion of US-19904 driven through the bin as a child process over a scratch copy of a committed fixture project under test/fixtures/rc-46/, its own devDependencies installed with npm ci (RC-46, round D).
title: rcf audit test-strength over TypeScript: tsx node:test, vitest and @playwright/test bound tests and .ts, .tsx and .vue Code Nodes (external, through bin/rcf.js)
